_comment: Shared truth table for EVENT_SOURCE, the source a workload publishes with.
Four places compute it, one per kind of workload, and they cannot share code:
app/events.go (eventSource) computes the same value for the own_source_only
condition of events.produces, and modules/events checks it against the
workload contract's event_source. This file is read by a Go test and by a
test in each of the three owning modules, so a change to one formula fails
The reserved workload name backend keeps a service from taking the backend's
source: a service named backend would publish as ${project}.backend.

vectors.name: a service is the project and its name
a service name with a hyphen is kept as written
a scheduled task sits under task
an event task sits under event
